name: automation
description: MQTT drivers and rules for core's devices: sensors, buttons, plugs and lights that announce themselves over MQTT (Home Assistant discovery, Shelly) become devices under /dev, and rules switch them when a reading, a press or the clock says so

options.label: MQTT broker
options.description: The broker devices talk to, as mqtt://host:1883 or mqtts://host:8883. setup.sh --mqtt runs one beside EiN and sets this.
options.emptyMeans: automation is off: no device is heard

options.label: MQTT user
options.description: The account EiN signs in to the broker with.
options.emptyMeans: EiN signs in without an account

options.label: MQTT password
options.description: The password of the MQTT user, sent only to the broker above. No shell sees it, and nothing shows it once it is set.

options.label: Device sources
options.description: Which kinds of device the bridge listens for, and drives, separated by spaces: ha-discovery (anything that announces itself the way Home Assistant reads, such as ESPHome), shelly (Shelly's second generation and later) and shelly-gen1 (Shelly's first generation: Plug S, 1, 1PM, 2.5, i3).

options.label: Discovery prefix
options.description: The topic devices announce themselves under, for ha-discovery.

options.label: Reading history
options.description: How long an endpoint's values are kept. Applies to endpoints found from now on; one found before keeps its own (change it with attrs on the endpoint).

options.label: Seconds between readings
options.description: The shortest time between two numbers of one endpoint that are kept and published: a number that comes sooner waits, and only the newest of those is kept. On and off, words and presses are kept as they come. Given to endpoints found from now on, as their minInterval attr, which may be changed on each.
